 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Pawan Kumar Joshi, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Pankaj Joshi, Aga for the State.

The applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No.103 of 2023, dated 28.04.2023, under Sections 363,
366, 376(3) Ipc and Sections 5(l)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
Police Station Banbhulpura, District Nainital.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has not supported the prosecution case during trial; she has already been examined during trial; there is no other evidence against the applicant.
4. These facts are admitted to the learned State counsel.
It makes out the case for bail.
5. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
7. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
